items.title: Add red repro for silent validate idle-kill
items.context: Create a focused repro showing that a long silent validate command can trigger the lifecycle idle watchdog before the fix. Acceptance: the repro fails before implementation and does not pass by disabling the watchdog or skipping validate.

items.title: Implement JSON-safe progress and heartbeat
items.context: Emit validate command start/end progress and flushed long-command heartbeat without corrupting --json stdout. Acceptance: long-running validate commands refresh parent lastActivity, stdout remains parseable JSON, and heartbeat does not extend command timeoutMs.

items.title: Harden forced-exit cleanup and stale-lock classification
items.context: Ensure watchdog termination is two-stage where possible and validation locks are not considered active solely because of PID reuse. Acceptance: vanished or mismatched owners are stale, active owners are not stolen, and the approach stays host-neutral.

items.title: Classify runner infrastructure failure separately from test failure
items.context: Forced exits and lifecycle runner failures should be reflected as infra failures, not ordinary test failures. Acceptance: watchdog/runner failures record infra_failure while ordinary test assertion failures still record test failure.

items.title: Verify story_advance TEST integration and safety regressions
items.context: Prove story_advance --phase=TEST survives active heartbeat and true hangs still fail closed. Acceptance: REVIEW -> TEST no longer dies from validate silence, diagnostics identify timed-out commands, and non-heartbeating hangs still fail.
